study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping cerebellar anatomical heterogeneity in mental and neurological illnesses

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABIDE, ADHD200, AOMIC ID1000, Beijing Enhanced, CAMCAN, CoRR, DLBS, DS000119, DS000202, DS000222, Fcon1000 (FCON), HBN, HCP, MPI Lemon (LEMON), NKI-Rockland (NKI), OASIS-3, PING, SALD, SLIM, UK Biobank, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, PNC, and TOP.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The cohort of individuals without diagnoses was obtained from 132 scanning sites, including various studies such as ABIDE, ADHD200, AOMIC ID1000, Beijing Enhanced, CAMCAN, CoRR, DLBS, DS000119, DS000202, DS000222, Fcon1000, HBN, HCP, MPI Lemon, NKI-Rockland, OASIS-3, PING, SALD, SLIM, and UK Biobank... As for the clinical datasets, we combined data from ABIDE, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, and TOP.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Kim2023.pdf.md: Methods / Population data and Clinical data, L132-L148

answer.ADNI: normative training/testing and clinical patient (AD, MCI)

answer.AIBL: normative training/testing and clinical patient (AD, MCI)

answer.TOP: normative training/testing and clinical patient (SZ, BD, MCI, AD, ASD)

answer.MULTI-SITE (N>=2): normative training/testing (includes AOMIC, Beijing, CoRR, DLBS, PING, SALD, SLIM and others)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Most datasets provided controls for both normative training and testing (evaluating model fit in controls). ABIDE, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, and TOP also provided clinical samples for ASD, AD, MCI, BD, and SZ respectively.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The individuals without diagnoses were first stratified on the basis of the scanning sites... we evenly split the control participants from each scanning site between the training and testing sets... As for the clinical datasets, we combined data from ABIDE, ADNI, AIBL, DEMGEN, and TOP.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Model-1 maps 28 cerebellar lobular volumes. Model-2 maps approximately 143,000 voxels. Both were trained on the same 27,117 training set and tested on the 26,985 testing set of controls.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: The total number of participants in the individuals-without-diagnosis population was 54,102... Training set | 27,117... Testing set | 26,985
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Kim2023.pdf.md: Methods / Population data, L141; Table 1, L106

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall mean and SD were calculated using weighted mean and pooled SD from the training (N=27117, mean=54.36, SD=20.31) and testing (N=26985, mean=54.52, SD=20.19) sets. Weighted Mean = (27117*54.36 + 26985*54.52) / 54102 = 54.44. Pooled SD = sqrt(((27117-1)*20.31^2 + (26985-1)*20.19^2) / (54102-2)) = 20.25. Min and Max are from the described population range.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: The age range spanned from 3 to 85 years... Training set: 54.36 (20.31)... Testing set: 54.52 (20.19)

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The sex ratio was reported as 53% female and 47% male for both the training and testing sets of the individuals without diagnosis population (N=54,102). Calculations: female_n = 54102 * 0.53 = 28674; male_n = 54102 * 0.47 = 25428.
